tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The uncoated cream sheet everything is printed on. Never use pure white as a page ground.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and footers that need to sit apart from paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, small text, buttons and form borders on paper or paper-deep. The only color for text under 24px.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Headings 24px and larger, the logo frog, line art and leaf veins on paper. Too light for small text.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Large discs behind the frog and behind products. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Leaves and foliage shapes. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The accent: small discs, bars under headings, the hard offset behind buttons, the caution stamp. Never text under 24px.

tokens.name: over-orange
tokens.usage: What pink over yellow prints as. Use only where a flat fallback is needed and blending is unavailable.

tokens.name: over-green
tokens.usage: What green over yellow prints as. Flat fallback only.

tokens.name: over-navy
tokens.usage: What teal over pink prints as. Flat fallback only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, cut guides and legal small print. Not a brand ink.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The shop name and one hero line per page. Uppercase, teal.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section titles. Teal, with a pink bar beneath.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Closed rings that sit between stitches and slip from needle to needle.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Set of six. Fits needles to US 8.
styles.usage: Captions, meta and form help, in ink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and table headers, in ink.

styles.name: script
styles.usage: Short asides: the Est. line, Latin names, a price note. One per block.

styles.name: hand
styles.usage: Figure labels and speech-bubble words. A few words at most.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and stamps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a title and its bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; button padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gap.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Stamps and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, bars and chips.

shadow.note: Riso has no soft shadows. The only depth is a second ink printed slightly off.

tokens.name: offset-pink
tokens.usage: Hard pink offset behind buttons and cards. Never blur it.

tokens.name: offset-yellow
tokens.usage: Alternative hard offset on pink-heavy layouts.
